name: 瑞士国际主义
description: Swiss International Style，极左对齐+Helvetica 无衬线+超大字距+钴蓝 #0047AB 点缀。H1 35px 左靠紧压-0.03em 字距、H2 小号 uppercase 3px 字距+细底线、H3 钴蓝、blockquote 纯左竖线无背景。骨架硬朗，适合设计/技术/信息类深度文。

styles.h1: font-size: 35px; font-weight: 800; color: #000000; text-align: left; line-height: 1.08; margin-top: 42px; margin-bottom: 28px; letter-spacing: -0.03em;
styles.h2: font-size: 22px; font-weight: 700; color: #000000; line-height: 1.3; margin-top: 38px; margin-bottom: 14px; padding-bottom: 6px; border-bottom: 1px solid #000000; letter-spacing: 1px;
styles.h3: font-size: 20px; font-weight: 700; color: #0047AB; line-height: 1.3; margin-top: 28px; margin-bottom: 12px; letter-spacing: -0.01em;
styles.h4: font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; color: #666666; margin-top: 22px; margin-bottom: 10px; line-height: 1.3; letter-spacing: 2.5px; text-transform: uppercase;
styles.h5: font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; color: #333333; margin-top: 18px; margin-bottom: 8px; line-height: 1.4;
styles.h6: font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; color: #999999; margin-top: 16px; margin-bottom: 6px; line-height: 1.4;
styles.p: font-size: 16px; color: #111111; line-height: 1.75; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 16px; text-align: left; letter-spacing: 0.3px;
styles.blockquote: border-left: 3px solid #000000; background: transparent; margin-top: 22px; margin-bottom: 22px; font-size: 15px; color: #333333; line-height: 1.7; font-style: italic;
styles.blockquote p: font-size: 15px; color: #333333; line-height: 1.7; margin-bottom: 0; background: transparent; font-style: italic;
styles.img: max-width: 100%; border-radius: 0; display: block; margin-top: 16px; margin-bottom: 16px; background: transparent;
styles.hr: margin-top: 32px; margin-bottom: 32px; height: 2px; width: 80px; background: #000000; border: none;
styles.code: background: #F5F5F5; border-radius: 0; font-size: 90%; color: #000000; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono','SF Mono',Menlo,monospace;
styles.pre: background: #F5F5F5; border: none; border-radius: 0; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0; overflow: hidden; color: #000000; overflow-x: auto; font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.6; white-space: pre-wrap; word-wrap: break-word;
styles.pre::before: display: flex; align-items: center; height: 28px; background: #000000; color: #FFFFFF; font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: 2px; text-transform: uppercase;
styles.pre code: background: none; color: #000000; font-size: 13px; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono','SF Mono',Menlo,monospace;
styles.table: width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; margin-top: 20px; margin-bottom: 20px; font-size: 13px;
styles.th: text-align: left; font-weight: 700; color: #000000; background: transparent; border-bottom: 2px solid #000000; letter-spacing: 1.5px; text-transform: uppercase; font-size: 11px;
styles.li: font-size: 16px; color: #111111; line-height: 1.75; letter-spacing: 0.3px; display: flex; margin-bottom: 6px; align-items: flex-start;
styles.footnotes h2: font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; color: #000000; margin-bottom: 10px; letter-spacing: 2.5px; text-transform: uppercase;
styles.footnotes li: font-size: 13px; color: #555555; margin-bottom: 6px; line-height: 1.5; word-break: break-all;
